about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: A brief overview of my experience and approach
paragraphs: My name is Alexey. I'm a frontend developer with 6+ years of commercial experience, currently growing into fullstack with the Next.js + TypeScript stack.

Throughout my career, I've worked at major IT companies (T1, Technoserv) and smaller products. I've designed CRM systems for the automotive and recruitment industries, launched recommendation platforms with Web3 integration, and developed Chrome extensions to automate recruiters' work. I managed a team of 3 frontend developers, conducted code reviews, and mentored colleagues.

My approach is not just to 'write code' but to solve a business problem. I think about architecture, performance, and testability from the first line. I believe good code is code that's easy to maintain a year from now.
